verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a hosted cloud service, so a public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a status page, uptime history, or postmortems. The session observability features (logs, live view, replay) are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
